title: GENIUS Act rulemaking tracker

statute.name: Guiding and Establishing National Innovation for U.S. Stablecoins Act (GENIUS Act)
statute.rulemaking_deadline_note: The Act directs the primary federal payment stablecoin regulators to issue implementing rules within one year of enactment.
statute.effective_note: The Act takes effect on the earlier of January 18, 2027 (18 months after enactment) or 120 days after the primary federal payment stablecoin regulators issue final implementing regulations.
statute.dasp_restriction_note: From three years after enactment, digital asset service providers may offer or sell only payment stablecoins issued by permitted payment stablecoin issuers to persons in the United States.

rulemakings.name: Treasury: payment stablecoin issuance, offer and sale, including by foreign payment stablecoin issuers
rulemakings.status_label: Comment period closed; final action pending
rulemakings.note: Would add a new Treasury rule on who may issue payment stablecoins in the United States and when digital asset service providers may offer or sell them to U.S. persons, including foreign issuers that meet the GENIUS Act's conditions for issuers regulated under a comparable foreign regime. The comment period closed October 19, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. Eastern.
